import java.util.*;

public class CF939F_Variant1 {
    static final int INF = (int) 1e8;
    static BufferedReader input;
    static PrintWriter output;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        if (System.getProperty("ONLINE_JUDGE") == null) {
            input = new BufferedReader(new FileReader("D:\\DataBase\\TESTCASE\\codeforces\\CF939F.in"));
        } else {
            input = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        }
        output = new PrintWriter(new BufferedOutputStream(System.out));
        solve();
        output.flush();
    }

    static void solve() throws IOException {
        int n = nextInt();
        int k = nextInt();

        int[][] intervals = new int[k + 2][2];
        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            intervals[i][0] = nextInt();
            intervals[i][1] = nextInt();
        }
        intervals[k + 1][0] = 2 * n;
        intervals[k + 1][1] = 2 * n;
        k++;

        Node[] dp = new Node[2];
        dp[0] = Node.build(0, n);
        dp[1] = Node.build(0, n);

        int[] data = new int[n + 1];

        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            Node cur = dp[i & 1];
            Node prev = dp[(i - 1) & 1];

            int[] interval = intervals[i];
            int len = interval[1] - interval[0];
            int gap = interval[0] - intervals[i - 1][1];

            Node.toArray(0, n, data, prev);
            int shift = Math.min(data.length, len + gap);
            System.arraycopy(data, 0, data, shift, Math.max(0, n + 1 - shift));
            Arrays.fill(data, 0, shift, INF);

            int minX = interval[1] - gap - len;
            int maxX = interval[1] - gap;

            for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                int minNeedTime = Node.query(minX - j, maxX - j, 0, n, prev);
                data[j] = Math.min(data[j], minNeedTime + 1);
            }

            for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                int minNeedTime = Node.query(j - gap - len, j - gap, 0, n, prev);
                data[j] = Math.min(data[j], minNeedTime + 2);
            }

            Node.fromArray(0, n, data, cur);
        }

        int result = Node.query(n, n, 0, n, dp[k & 1]);

        if (result < INF) {
            output.println("Full");
            output.println(result);
        } else {
            output.println("Hungry");
        }
    }

    static int nextInt() throws IOException {
        int c;
        while ((c = input.read()) <= ' ') ;
        boolean neg = c == '-';
        if (c == '-' || c == '+') c = input.read();
        int x = 0;
        while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
            x = x * 10 + c - '0';
            c = input.read();
        }
        return neg ? -x : x;
    }

    static class Node {
        Node left, right;
        int batchValue;
        boolean dirty;
        int min;

        static void setValue(int f, int t, int l, int r, int val, Node node) {
            if (f > r || t < l) return;
            if (f <= l && t >= r) {
                node.setValue(val);
                return;
            }
            node.pushDown();
            int m = (l + r) >>> 1;
            setValue(f, t, l, m, val, node.left);
            setValue(f, t, m + 1, r, val, node.right);
            node.pushUp();
        }

        static Node build(int l, int r) {
            Node node = new Node();
            if (l != r) {
                int m = (l + r) >>> 1;
                node.left = build(l, m);
                node.right = build(m + 1, r);
            }
            return node;
        }

        static int query(int f, int t, int l, int r, Node node) {
            if (f > r || t < l) return INF;
            if (f <= l && r <= t) return node.min;
            node.pushDown();
            int m = (l + r) >>> 1;
            return Math.min(query(f, t, l, m, node.left), query(f, t, m + 1, r, node.right));
        }

        static void update(int i, int l, int r, int val, Node node) {
            if (i > r || i < l) return;
            if (i <= l && i >= r) {
                node.min = Math.min(node.min, val);
                return;
            }
            node.pushDown();
            int m = (l + r) >>> 1;
            update(i, l, m, val, node.left);
            update(i, m + 1, r, val, node.right);
            node.pushUp();
        }

        static void toArray(int l, int r, int[] data, Node node) {
            if (l == r) {
                data[l] = node.min;
                return;
            }
            node.pushDown();
            int m = (l + r) >>> 1;
            toArray(l, m, data, node.left);
            toArray(m + 1, r, data, node.right);
        }

        static void fromArray(int l, int r, int[] data, Node node) {
            if (l == r) {
                node.min = data[l];
                return;
            }
            node.dirty = false;
            int m = (l + r) >>> 1;
            fromArray(l, m, data, node.left);
            fromArray(m + 1, r, data, node.right);
            node.pushUp();
        }

        void pushUp() {
            min = Math.min(left.min, right.min);
        }

        void setValue(int val) {
            min = val;
            batchValue = val;
            dirty = true;
        }

        void pushDown() {
            if (dirty) {
                left.setValue(batchValue);
                right.setValue(batchValue);
                dirty = false;
            }
        }
    }
}

import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class CF939F_Variant2 {
    static final int INF = (int) 1e8;
    static BufferedReader br;
    static PrintWriter pw;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        if (System.getProperty("ONLINE_JUDGE") == null) {
            br = new BufferedReader(new FileReader("D:\\DataBase\\TESTCASE\\codeforces\\CF939F.in"));

        solve();
        pw.close();
    }

    static void solve() throws IOException {
        int n = nextInt();
        int k = nextInt();

        int[][] segs = new int[k + 2][2];
        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            segs[i][0] = nextInt();
            segs[i][1] = nextInt();
        }
        segs[k + 1][0] = 2 * n;
        segs[k + 1][1] = 2 * n;
        k++;

        SegTree[] dp = new SegTree[2];
        dp[0] = new SegTree(0, n);
        dp[1] = new SegTree(0, n);

        int[] buf = new int[n + 1];

        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            SegTree cur = dp[i & 1];
            SegTree prev = dp[(i - 1) & 1];

            int[] seg = segs[i];
            int segLen = seg[1] - seg[0];
            int gap = seg[0] - segs[i - 1][1];

            prev.toArray(buf);
            int cutoff = Math.min(buf.length, segLen + gap);
            System.arraycopy(buf, 0, buf, cutoff, Math.max(0, n + 1 - cutoff));
            Arrays.fill(buf, 0, cutoff, INF);

            int lo = seg[1] - gap - segLen;
            int hi = seg[1] - gap;

            for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                int val = prev.query(lo - j, hi - j);
                buf[j] = Math.min(buf[j], val + 1);
            }

            for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                int val = prev.query(j - gap - segLen, j - gap);
                buf[j] = Math.min(buf[j], val + 2);
            }

            cur.fromArray(buf);
        }

        int ans = dp[k & 1].query(n, n);
        if (ans < INF) {
            pw.println("Full");
            pw.println(ans);
        } else {
            pw.println("Hungry");
        }
    }

    static int nextInt() throws IOException {
        int c;
        while ((c = br.read()) <= ' ') ;
        boolean neg = c == '-';
        if (c == '-' || c == '+') c = br.read();
        int x = 0;
        while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
            x = x * 10 + c - '0';
            c = br.read();
        }
        return neg ? -x : x;
    }

    static class SegTree {
        SegTree left, right;
        int lazy;
        boolean isLazy;
        int minVal;

        SegTree(int l, int r) {
            if (l == r) {
                minVal = INF;
                return;
            }
            int mid = (l + r) >>> 1;
            left = new SegTree(l, mid);
            right = new SegTree(mid + 1, r);
            minVal = Math.min(left.minVal, right.minVal);
        }

        void setRange(int f, int t, int val) {
            setRange(f, t, 0, 100000, val, this);
        }

        void setRange(int f, int t, int l, int r, int val, SegTree node) {
            if (f > r || t < l) return;
            if (f <= l && t >= r) {
                node.lazy = val;
                node.isLazy = true;
                node.minVal = val;
                return;
            }
            node.pushDown();
            int m = (l + r) >>> 1;
            setRange(f, t, l, m, val, node.left);
            setRange(f, t, m + 1, r, val, node.right);
            node.minVal = Math.min(node.left.minVal, node.right.minVal);
        }

        int query(int f, int t) {
            return query(f, t, 0, 100000, this);
        }

        int query(int f, int t, int l, int r, SegTree node) {
            if (f > r || t < l) return INF;
            if (f <= l && r <= t) return node.minVal;
            node.pushDown();
            int m = (l + r) >>> 1;
            return Math.min(query(f, t, l, m, node.left), query(f, t, m + 1, r, node.right));
        }

        void update(int idx, int val) {
            update(idx, 0, 100000, val, this);
        }

        void update(int idx, int l, int r, int val, SegTree node) {
            if (idx < l || idx > r) return;
            if (l == r) {
                node.minVal = Math.min(node.minVal, val);
                return;
            }
            node.pushDown();
            int m = (l + r) >>> 1;
            update(idx, l, m, val, node.left);
            update(idx, m + 1, r, val, node.right);
            node.minVal = Math.min(node.left.minVal, node.right.minVal);
        }

        void toArray(int[] arr) {
            toArray(0, 100000, arr, this);
        }

        void toArray(int l, int r, int[] arr, SegTree node) {
            if (l == r) {
                arr[l] = node.minVal;
                return;
            }
            node.pushDown();
            int m = (l + r) >>> 1;
            toArray(l, m, arr, node.left);
            toArray(m + 1, r, arr, node.right);
        }

        void fromArray(int[] arr) {
            fromArray(0, 100000, arr, this);
        }

        void fromArray(int l, int r, int[] arr, SegTree node) {
            if (l == r) {
                node.minVal = arr[l];
                return;
            }
            node.isLazy = false;
            int m = (l + r) >>> 1;
            fromArray(l, m, arr, node.left);
            fromArray(m + 1, r, arr, node.right);
            node.minVal = Math.min(node.left.minVal, node.right.minVal);
        }

        void pushDown() {
            if (isLazy) {
                left.lazy = lazy;
                left.isLazy = true;
                left.minVal = lazy;
                right.lazy = lazy;
                right.isLazy = true;
                right.minVal = lazy;
                isLazy = false;
            }
        }
    }
